## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues (for example,
`Closes #123`).

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For code or data changes, use
`npm run check`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, and
`npm run test:production`. For documentation-only changes, check formatting and
links. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Screenshots or source evidence

For visible changes, include screenshots using sample data. For calculations or
data changes, link the official source, edition/validity dates, and page/table;
include an input with its expected result. Delete this section if it does not apply.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Validation appropriate to the change is described above.
- [ ] Applicable accessibility, offline, and privacy behavior has been checked.
- [ ] Applicable data attribution, metadata, coverage, and rounding behavior are documented.
